generated_agent_source:
import csv
import io


def process_transaction(row):
    return {
        "transaction_id": row["transaction_id"],
        "date": row["date"],
        "account": row["account"],
        "description": row["description"],
        "counterparty": row["counterparty"],
        "amount": row["amount"],
        "currency": row["currency"],
        "reference": row["reference"],
        "direction": row["direction"],
        "category": "Other",
        "rule_matched": "No Match",
        "rule_used": "No Match",
        "confidence_score": 0.5,
        "review_required": True,
    }


def write_exceptions(processed_rows):
    exception_rows = [row for row in processed_rows if row["review_required"]]
    buffer = io.StringIO()
    writer = csv.DictWriter(
        buffer,
        fieldnames=["transaction_id", "review_required", "rule_matched"],
    )
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerows(exception_rows)
    return buffer.getvalue()


def main():
    row = {
        "transaction_id": "TXN001",
        "date": "2024-01-01",
        "account": "Main",
        "description": "Misc charge",
        "counterparty": "Vendor",
        "amount": "10.00",
        "currency": "GBP",
        "reference": "REF1",
        "direction": "debit",
    }
    processed_rows = [process_transaction(row)]
    write_exceptions(processed_rows)
